name: Zellberg Stüberl
kurzbeschreibung: Alpine inn on the Zillertaler Höhenstraße at 1,840 m, run by Gerhard Zellberg Buam and his son Georg with live folk music at midday.
beschreibung: The Zellberg Stüberl is an alpine inn on the Zillertaler Höhenstraße in Zellberg in the Zillertal. Situated at around 1,840 metres above sea level, it is regarded as a popular excursion destination with sweeping views of the Zillertal mountains. The Stüberl is run by Gerhard, head of the Zellberg Buam, and his son Georg (Die Fetzig'n aus dem Zillertal). When the bands are not on tour, live folk music is played at midday from about 12:00 to 14:00 amid the Zillertal Alps. About a five-minute walk uphill is the establishment's own chapel. The Zillertaler Höhenstraße is suitable for private cars and buses with up to 30 seats. The Zellberg Stüberl is open daily from 09:00 to 18:00, in the 2026 season presumably from 8 May to 31 October.
